main.description: Share an existing private gallery with another account. Adds them to the space's member list on the author's PDS, which is what the authority consults when it mints a credential.

actor.description: Handle or DID of the account to share with.

errors.name: NotAuthorized
errors.description: Only the gallery's author may add members.

errors.name: ActorNotFound
errors.description: The handle could not be resolved.
